questions: Can you tell me about Karthipuram?
What kind of project is this?
How many acres is the project?
Give me an overview of the project
answer: Karthipuram is a 190-acre integrated township in Coimbatore with residential and commercial plots, parks, wide roads and full underground infrastructure. It's built so everything you need is inside the township.
facts: Integrated township with residential and commercial plots
Located in Coimbatore, the Manchester of South India
Tagline: Step through the door to your dream place

questions: What are the key numbers of the project?
answer: In 190 acres we have 1,882 housing plots and 213 commercial plots, 10 parks including a 9-acre central park, over 1,200 trees, 15 entrance ways and three types of water connection.

questions: Who is the promoter of Karthipuram?
Which company is behind this project?
answer: Karthipuram is developed by Unnamalai Promoters Private Limited, part of the Unnamalai Group. The founder is Thiru P. Karthikeyan. They have been developing layouts across Tamil Nadu since 1989.

questions: What other projects have you done?
How long have you been in business?
How many projects have you delivered?
answer: We have been developing since 1989, with projects across Kovilpatti, Tirupur, Dindugul, Dharapuram, Gobi, Sathy and Sulur. Our largest so far was 850 acres at Kovilpatti New Town, and we also built two colleges.
facts: 2002 Kovilpatti New Town Suba Nagar, 850 acres
2011 Naveen Nagar and Soundaraja Airport Nagar, Dindugul, 63 acres
2019 Unnamalai Nagar, Sathvika Nagar, Adhvitha Nagar, Tirupur, 11 acres
2020 Unnamalai College of Arts and Science, Kovilpatti

On the Kalapatti to Arasur SH Road

topic: How many plots and what types

How many commercial plots are there?
What types of plots do you have?
answer: The township has 1,882 housing plots and 213 commercial plots.

questions: What is the road width inside the township?
How much road network is there?
answer: We have 80, 60 and 40-feet tar roads, with the 80 and 60-feet roads stretching over 4 kilometres. There are 15 entrance ways into the township.

questions: How big is the central park?
What facilities are in the parks?
Is there a children's play area?
Is there a cricket practice net?
answer: There are 10 parks including a beautifully landscaped 9-acre central park at the heart of the township, designed for morning walks, family time and community gatherings.

questions: Can I see the Nilgiri mountains?
Can I see the Aanaikatti hills?
answer: We have over 1,200 trees and 10 parks. The site sits at the highest altitude in the surrounding region, so you get views of the Nilgiri mountains to the north and sunsets over the Aanaikatti hills to the west, with a cool evening breeze.
facts: Highest altitude in the surrounding region
Nilgiri Mountains view to the north
Sunset over Aanaikatti hills to the west

questions: Are there engineering colleges close by?
